remove: 第 17 章と Test 10 記録票
Data Agent の評価は、10 問の口語・敵対的な質問で行います。すべて 1 問 1 会話（fresh conversation）で実施し、質問文をそのまま貼り付けます。答えは事前に Agent へ教えません。記録は別冊の Test 10 記録票を使用します。
ここまでで原因が特定できない場合は、サービス側の要因を疑う。実行エラー・タイムアウト・応答なしは、権限・参照先・構成の誤りでも起こりうる。一時障害かを切り分ける間は設定を変えずに同じ質問を最大 2 回まで再実行し、3 回目も失敗したら時刻・質問 ID・エラー本文と確認済み事項を記録してエスカレーションする。これは Test 10 記録票の切り分け表の最終行と同じ手順である。
全 50 パラメーターは、このガイドと同じ配布版の処理仕様ワークブックの `Parameters` シートに 1 枚でまとまっています。Core で参加者が変更するものだけを抜き出した `Parameters_Core` シートもあります。

add.公開文書は、参加者ガイド Word 1 点と同じ版の HTML 1 点です。検証: The public document set is one participant Word guide and one HTML guide of the same edition. The validation-record Word and processing-specification XLSX are optional internal companions, not part of the public set. Chapter 17 contains the evaluation criteria and recording instructions; Appendix B indexes the specifications for every parameter. Workshop notebooks, code and data are not bundled with this document pair. Confirm their separate delivery before starting the hands-on work.
add.第 17 章の評価基準とガイド内の記録方法: Chapter 17 evaluation criteria and in-guide recording instructions
add.Data Agent の評価は、10 問の口語・敵対的な質問で行います。すべて: Data Agent evaluation uses 10 colloquial and adversarial questions. Ask each question in a fresh conversation and paste the question text unchanged. Do not teach the Agent the answers in advance. In the public edition, use this chapter's evaluation criteria and the recording instructions below.
add.公開版の記録方法: Recording results with the public edition
add.別冊のダウンロードは不要です。ご自身の非公開の記録に、実施日時・実施者・対象 W: No separate record download is required. In your own private record, note the time, operator, target Workspace / Folder, actual Data Agent ID, configuration edition, runtime, Draft / Published, Core / Optional, additional tools, and reasons for any unrun or blocked steps. For each question record its ID and original wording, actual answer, sources used, stable IDs, numbers, grain, period, boundaries, refusal reasons, execution-detail references, verdict and observations. Count all four verdicts. Keep Core verdicts separate from optional comparisons. Also record changes, retest times, retry counts and remaining issues. Preserve the original answers. Crop or redact accounts, URLs and internal IDs only in copies of screenshots intended for publication, and disclose the edited regions. Never edit an answer to turn it into PASS. Do not copy questions, expected values or results into the Agent configuration.
add.ここまでで原因が特定できない場合は、サービス側の要因を疑う。実行エラー・タイムア: If the cause is still not identified, suspect a service-side factor. Execution errors, timeouts, and missing responses can also result from incorrect permissions, referenced targets, or configuration. While checking whether the failure is transient, retry the same question at most 2 times without changing settings. If the 3rd attempt also fails, record the time, question ID, error text, and checks already performed, then escalate. Follow the same procedure if using the optional internal Test 10 record sheet.
add.全パラメーターの完全な仕様表は、この付録の索引が示す第 6.4 節・第 15.2: Complete specifications for every parameter are in sections 6.4 and 15.2 and Appendices D.1-D.3, as indexed here. This guide contains their defaults, change conditions and safety gates. The processing-specification workbook is an optional internal companion; no XLSX download is required to follow the public edition.
